tasks.summary: Implement public static CeilingTo(decimal value, decimal multiple) in src/Rounding.cs under namespace LoopLab.Rounding, computing the smallest multiple >= value, preserving the scale of multiple, and throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException (paramName multiple) for non-positive multiples.

Add unit tests in tests/unit/RoundingTests.cs covering positive basic rounding and exact-multiple boundary, negative value rounding and its boundary, zero/negative multiple exception with ParamName check, and scale preservation of the returned decimal via decimal.GetBits.
